decisions.reason: A black-finish range is a low-cost extension of existing lines that follows the current design trend in bathrooms, so there is little reason to withdraw it after one year.
A shower channel for seamless coverings fits the firm's core barrier-free bathroom strategy and has its own page, which signals strategic importance.
The pump-assisted solution is more novel and only mentioned on the website, but it serves renovation cases with little floor depth and the development effort is already sunk, so keeping it is likely.
A tileable floor drain is close to the firm's established offer and has its own page, so it is cheap to keep and likely in steady demand from tilers and installers.
A stainless steel design grate matches the firm's design-led positioning and its own manufacturing, so it carries a low risk of withdrawal.
